operations.title: The conductor-supported component of the physical localization triangle has zero elliptic infinity image on the nonsoft open
operations.statement: Disjointness of conductor and infinity support implies i_infinity^! i_C*=0, so every geometrically supported conductor-to-elliptic kernel has rank zero. A full relative elliptic comparison remains possible only through extra bulk-extension or physical-chain nullhomotopy data.
